environment: **Internal infrastructure subnets**: 192.168.100.0/20 (Infra VLAN), 192.168.200.0/24 (Storage LAN), 10.21.21.0/24 (nwlab WG overlay)
**This is an infrastructure repo** — no build/lint/test toolchain. Verification is done via SSH to target hosts and service health checks.
**SSH read commands are safe** — status checks, docker ps, mount checks, dig, curl to internal services. These do not modify state.
**SSH write commands require confirmation** — docker-compose up/down, systemctl restart, config file writes, any destructive operations on remote hosts.
**Never auto-approve**: rm -rf, qm destroy, pct destroy, zfs destroy, systemctl stop on production services, docker-compose down without explicit request.
**Deploy pattern**: edit config locally → scp/rsync to VM → restart service on VM. Each step should be confirmed separately.
**shellcheck all .sh files** before committing — this repo has no CI, shell validation is manual.
